summary: CAIR Action endorsed Anne Kepner in the 2026 general election for Trustee Area 3, West Valley-Mission Community College District, a recommendation the record treats as concrete stance evidence on Gaza and ceasefire positions. Activist Samir Laymoun separately supported her candidacy, though his input is designated as an opinion source distinct from official community positions and does not by itself establish shared policy views. Kepner's campaign platform centers on education leadership and community college advocacy.
